about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: We are not just a booking platform — we are a digital gateway unlocking Syria's tourism treasures, with global design and authentic local experience
about.story_title: A Journey That Started as a Dream... and Became Reality
about.story_p1: Our idea began with a simple observation: Syria is a country rich in archaeological and natural treasures — from ancient Palmyra to the Latakia coast, from Old Damascus to Krak des Chevaliers — yet most of these gems remain out of reach due to the lack of a unified digital platform.
about.story_p2: That's why we decided to build a world-class platform that combines the ease of Booking.com, the community of TripAdvisor, and the integrated experience of Expedia — with an authentic Syrian touch that understands local and Arab travelers.
about.promise_1: Complete transparency in prices and services
about.promise_2: Real human support, not just chatbots
about.promise_3: Top-tier protection of your personal data
about.promise_4: Refunds according to our cancellation policy
about.vision_desc: To be the leading digital platform in Syria and the region for showcasing Syria's tourism wonders to the world, and a role model for digital transformation in the tourism sector.
about.mission_desc: To provide an integrated, secure, and easy tourism booking experience connecting travelers with Syria's most beautiful destinations, ensuring the highest standards of quality and transparency.
about.values_desc: Quality, transparency, security, innovation, and respect for our customers' time and trust. We put the traveler's comfort at the forefront of every detail.
about.why_security_desc: Secure payments through the certified SamaPay gateway with full data encryption
about.why_fast_desc: From browsing to confirmation in minutes, without waiting or phone calls
about.why_support_desc: A dedicated team ready to help you anytime, anywhere
about.why_quality_desc: Trusted partners: hotels, transport companies, and certified tour guides
about.why_global_desc: Modern bilingual interface with full support for mobile, tablet, and desktop
about.why_trust_desc: Thousands of satisfied travelers with real reviews from previous customers
about.cmp_title: We Follow the Best Global Platforms
about.cmp_subtitle: We've drawn inspiration from industry giants and applied best practices tailored to the Syrian and Arab market
about.cmp_conclusion_title: ✨ We Take the Best From Them... and Add an Authentic Syrian Touch
about.cmp_conclusion: Same security, same ease, same global quality — but with a deep understanding of the Arab traveler's needs and full support for local language and culture.
about.cta_title: Ready to Discover Syria Like Never Before?
about.cta_subtitle: Join thousands of travelers who trust us to plan their trips
